title: triagecap: autoFileDemotionDefect writes through a fixed .tmp path and ignores the rename error; an init guard can never fire; malformed-companion warnings have no caller
summary: Found by comment-reduction batch 5 (2026-09-26) and reported without changing code. (1) autoFileDemotionDefect writes through a fixed path+".tmp" and ignores the rename error. That is the concurrent-writer collision internal/recovery fixed with atomicwrite (ADR-0049): two lanes demoting at once share one temp file, and a failed rename is silent. (2) The init guard in floors.go can never fire: package vars initialize before init, so topNHeadingRE's index panics first. (3) MalformedCommittedFloorWarning and MalformedDeferredFloorWarning have no production caller, so a malformed companion falls back to prose silently. (4) SelectWaveSeedTopN and ShouldDemote are reached only from tests and ACS predicates; Review calls demotionDecision directly. (5) readWindow uses context.Background() and ignores Review's ctx.
fix: Write the demotion defect through atomicwrite and return or signal the rename error. Replace the init guard with a check that can fire, or remove it. Route the malformed-companion warnings through the review's Signal Center. Remove or wire the test-only seams. Pass Review's ctx into readWindow.
acceptance: Two concurrent autoFileDemotionDefect calls leave one complete, parseable defect file; a failed rename is reported (tests)
A malformed committed or deferred companion emits a coded WARN (test)
